rounds.text: Lippi Systems Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational transformation, evidenced by a dramatic surge in profitability metrics that far outpace historical averages. While the company struggled with a median return on equity of 1% over the last decade [E23], the most recent data confirms a robust ROE of 16.4% [E13] and a ROCE of 21% [E59]. This performance is not merely an outlier but a structural improvement, as the company is now generating an ROA of 12.95% compared to a sector benchmark of 4.17% [E8]. Furthermore, the market is currently valuing the stock at a P/E of 45.34x, which remains a discount to the sector benchmark of 59.4x [E6]. Conceded: the DCF analysis suggests the current price of ₹ 265 exceeds the intrinsic value of ₹ 219 [E38], and the 10-year median ROE remains low at 1% [E23]. Investors are clearly recognizing this momentum, as the stock is trading at 97% of its 52-week range [E5].
